This is not in the briefing, and the fires were in the south."},{"span":"They claim they are simply moving livestock","severity":"major","reason":"Invents a claim and livestock."},{"span":"caravan patrols","severity":"minor","reason":"Embellishes caravans into patrols."}],"voice":2,"clarity":2,"tone":3,"overall":1,"comment":"On a quiet week it invents a fresh raid, new figures and Kinn movements, and it contradicts itself by calling the week quiet straight after reporting attacks.
